title: Rav Chinena of Vardan
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: (It is a place-name, mentioned in Eruvin 49a and Gittin 41a.) Hyman mentions him once, in Gittin 64b, raising an objection against the words of Rav Chisda and Rav Yehudah, and Rav Chisda said: “Vardan has fallen silent” (Rashi explains: he was struck dumb and gave no reply to this answer).

notes.text: The supplied compressed expression is translated as raising an objection. Named Davidson Gittin 64b has Rav Chinena of Vardan raising the objection and then the Vardan/Chisda exchange. Hyman’s “only once” observation remains attributed to him; no new spelling is inserted into the Hebrew.
